ffmpeg version 9.0.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

# before this PR (script options, FFmpeg 6 to 8)
$ ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=s=320x180:d=1 -filter_script:v g.txt -frames:v 1 -f null -
Unrecognized option 'filter_script:v'.
Error splitting the argument list: Option not found
exit status 8

$ ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=s=320x180:d=1 -filter_complex_script gc.txt -map [v] -frames:v 1 -f null -
Unrecognized option 'filter_complex_script'.
Error splitting the argument list: Option not found
exit status 8

# this PR on FFmpeg 7.0+ (-/option file)
$ ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=s=320x180:d=1 -/vf g.txt -frames:v 1 -f null -
exit status 0

$ ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=s=320x180:d=1 -/filter_complex gc.txt -map [v] -frames:v 1 -f null -
exit status 0
